title: Berlin Itinerary for Couples - Quick Summary
items: **Each person chooses one must-do.** Do not negotiate every hour or build a long list of weak compromises.
**Place the least flexible promise first.** A timed museum, reservation or train shapes the rest of the day.
**Give each half-day one Berlin area.** Pair Museum Island with Hackescher Markt, or East Side Gallery with Oberbaumbrücke and Kreuzberg.
**Use one shared hinge.** A river pause, park, market or bridge connects two personal choices without becoming a third major attraction.
If the priorities are far apart, make the transport move explicit and leave one choice flexible rather than booking two distant anchors.
